content: Single-author CMS admin table stakes from headless-CMS vendor docs (Ibexa, DatoCMS, Strapi, Pantheon): draft/publish with explicit publish action; side-by-side translation editing with source language read-only next to editable target; preview that shows draft data (view-only is enough; split-pane iframe is the premium pattern, Strapi gates it behind paid tier); manual ordering via sortable lists; translation status filters. Little written guidance on manual ordering beyond 'sortable'.
